purpose: Evaluate RNA workflow routing across bulk, single-cell, generic coding, plotting, variant, and clinical neighbors.

cases.query: 从 paired-end FASTQ 规划 bulk RNA-seq 到 gene counts 的可复现流程，并写清 reference、strandedness 和 QC。
cases.rationale: FASTQ-to-counts bulk workflow design is core scope.

cases.query: 检查这个 raw count matrix 的样本身份、PCA、低表达过滤和 DESeq2 design，再定义 treatment contrast。
cases.rationale: Count-matrix QC and sample-level differential design are core bulk tasks.

cases.query: 为 10x scRNA-seq 设计 empty droplets、ambient RNA、doublet、batch integration 和 cell annotation 流程。
cases.rationale: Raw single-cell QC through annotation is core scope.

cases.query: 比较病例与对照的 T cells，请按 donor 做 pseudo-bulk，不要把每个 cell 当独立重复。
cases.rationale: Sample-aware single-cell condition testing is a central guardrail.

cases.query: 评估 rMATS 和 LeafCutter 哪个适合当前 short-read RNA-seq，并要求 junction support 与 event definition。
cases.rationale: Splicing method selection with evidence checks belongs to the RNA workflow.

cases.query: 我只有 processed h5ad；请审查还能可靠做哪些 QC、marker 和 condition comparison，并标出不能重建的步骤。
cases.rationale: Processed-only single-cell feasibility review is an explicit mode.

cases.query: 审查 Multiome 项目的 RNA layer：按 sample 做 QC、annotation 和 differential expression，并说明跨模态关联边界。
cases.rationale: The RNA layer of Multiome is within single-cell scope.

cases.query: 现有 scRNA 结果用 integrated values 做 DE 且 p 值把 cells 当独立样本，请诊断并给出可复现修复路线。
cases.rationale: Repairing invalid single-cell differential testing is core workflow review.

cases.query: 为 long-read RNA-seq 的 isoform switching 分析定义输入、coverage QC、结果表和验证止损线。
cases.rationale: Isoform workflow design and coverage boundaries belong to RNA analysis.

cases.query: 审查 pySCENIC 输出，区分 co-expression module、motif-pruned regulon 和 AUCell activity。
cases.rationale: RNA regulon-output interpretation with method boundaries is supported.

cases.query: 把已经确认的 DE 表画成期刊风格 volcano plot 和 heatmap，统一字体与色盲配色。
cases.rationale: Pure figure production belongs to publication plotting.

cases.query: 写一个通用 Python 函数，把任意 TSV 转成 Parquet 并加单元测试。
cases.rationale: Generic code engineering is not an RNA workflow task.

cases.query: 核验 rs123 的 genome build、REF/ALT、ClinVar assertion 和 gnomAD frequency。
cases.rationale: Variant identity and evidence belong to variant interpretation.

cases.query: 整理该药物所有临床试验的 phase、status、primary endpoint 和 results availability。
cases.rationale: Clinical-trial evidence review is outside RNA execution.

cases.query: 对论文中‘这个基因驱动疾病机制’的 claim 做逐条证据审计。
cases.rationale: A manuscript claim audit is broader than an RNA workflow.

cases.query: 系统检索过去五年关于单细胞批次校正的 benchmark 论文并做引用矩阵。
cases.rationale: The primary deliverable is a literature search, not RNA execution.

cases.query: 把 DEG 输入 Reactome 和 STRING，构建 pathway network 并解释模块。
cases.rationale: Downstream pathway/network analysis has its own workflow.

cases.query: 比较五个分类器预测 cell type 的性能，要求 nested CV、校准和外部验证。
cases.rationale: The primary task is ML benchmarking rather than a standard RNA workflow.

cases.query: 为 Figure 2 的 scRNA UMAP 和 marker panels 写完整图注。
cases.rationale: Caption writing is not analysis execution.

cases.query: 按 CCDS 重新整理整个项目的 FASTQ、counts、figures 和 manifest，但不要运行 RNA 分析。
cases.rationale: Project-wide artifact organization belongs to research-data-organization.
